items.title: Understanding Positive and Negative Numbers
items.explanation: A number with a '+' sign in front is called a positive number, while a number with a '-' sign in front is called a negative number. Zero is neither positive nor negative and does not have signs added to it. The ground floor is defined as Floor 0. Floors above the ground are numbered with positive numbers (e.g., +1, +2), and floors below are numbered with negative numbers (e.g., -1, -2).
